name: JetBrains PHPverse 2027
description: free online PHP community day by JetBrains, livestreamed on YouTube
note: online (YouTube livestream), English; no ticket needed
details:
PHPverse is JetBrains' one-day online event for the PHP community, streamed on YouTube with live Q&A in the chat and a Discord.

The 2026 edition (9 June, 13:00-18:30 CEST) had Fabien Potencier (Symfony), Jeffrey Way (Laracasts), Larry Garfield, Nils Adermann (Packagist), Elizabeth Barron (PHP Foundation) and others, hosted by Nuno Maduro and Brent Roose, on AI in development, Symfony, Composer/Packagist supply-chain security and the RFC process. A 2027 edition is not announced yet.
